newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News appoints corporate affairs v.p.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News appoints corporate affairs v.p.

text.p: Global media group News Corp Ltd said on Thursday it had appointed James R. Platt senior vice president of corporate affairs.

"Mr Platt, 40, will be responsible for coordinating press and public affiars for worldwide functions, developing a corporate communications function and handling administrative duties for the company's executive committee," News said.
Platt has worked as the head of News America's new media department, head of investor relations for News Corp and senior editor of Fox Broadcasting's "Front Page" programme.
